query: Uganda Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026 latest confirmed case count July 2026, any new case after 20 cumulative
answer:
I've completed the research and provided the structured findings.

**Summary:** As of 14 July 2026, **Uganda's Bundibugyo virus (Ebola) case count remains at 20 cumulative confirmed cases with 2 deaths — no new case beyond 20 has been reported.** The last Uganda case was confirmed on **21 June 2026**, and ECDC explicitly states no new cases have occurred since. This is cross-validated by the Uganda Ministry of Health dashboard, ECDC, WHO DON612, ReliefWeb Sit-Rep 08, and EbolaMap. Uganda's cluster appears contained (0 active contacts under follow-up), in sharp contrast to DRC, which is escalating rapidly (~1,963 cases / 719 deaths).
